director.purpose: Owns the goal. Breaks it into tasks across repos, sets dependencies, judges whether the result meets the ask.

manager.purpose: Owns one task. Writes the worker brief, dispatches, verifies the diff and tests, unblocks or escalates to the director.

coder.purpose: Implements a brief in one worktree. Manager may escalate to opus for cross-repo or subtle changes.

reviewer.purpose: Independent read of a finished diff. Never the same instance that wrote it.

searcher.purpose: Grep, file location, and fact lookups. Read-only.
